english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a sports or skills trainer.
This is the all-purpose choice for a person who trains or coaches others.

examples.english: My coach often does fitness training with me.
examples.traditional: 我個教練成日陪我操體能。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 go3 gaau3 lin6 seng4 jat6 pui4 ngo5 cou1 tai2 nang4

examples.english: That trainer trains us every day.
examples.traditional: 嗰位教練日日帶我哋操練。
examples.jyutping: go2 wai6 gaau3 lin6 jat6 jat6 daai2 ngo5 dei6 cou1 lin6
